name: StreamNexus.io Embed Videos
author: streamnexus.io

sections.description:
Easily embed your StreamNexus.io hosted videos or audio files into your WordPress site using a simple shortcode.
Copy and paste your shortcode from the StreamNexus.io backoffice, and the plugin automatically generates an HTML5 video player with adaptive HLS streaming, ensuring smooth delivery to all devices.

Features

  • Simple shortcode: [streamnexus-video media_id=”YOUR_VIDEO_ID”]
  • Adaptive Bitrate Streaming (ABR) with HLS
  • Optimized playback across desktop, tablet, and mobile
  • Lightweight and fast-loading HTML5 player
  • No complex setup – just install, activate, and paste your shortcode
  • No API key required – enter the media ID or share link directly in the shortcode
  • No more hosting MP4 files on your limited hosting provided allocated storage
  • Advanced Analytics, retention charts, playback events on the StreamNexus.io dashboard

Usage

Add the following shortcode inside any post or page:

[streamnexus-video media_id=”YOUR_VIDEO_ID”]

This will render the StreamNexus HTML5 player and deliver the video using adaptive bitrate HLS streaming, ensuring smooth playback for all viewers regardless of their bandwidth.

A video tutorial of embedding videos in a WordPress site is available on https://www.streamnexus.io

Requirements

  • A valid StreamNexus.io video id.

External service and policies

This plugin embeds the StreamNexus player hosted at https://api.streamnexus.io/player-page.html.

By using the player you are agreeing to StreamNexus’ service policies:
– Terms of Service: https://www.streamnexus.io/terms-of-service/
– Privacy Policy: https://www.streamnexus.io/privacy-policy/
